summary: Rewrote monthly_statement per the current Meridale pages (canonical tz/Etc zones, half-open range, only merchant_id/tz/from/to/locale sent, Decimal rounding to currency digits, locale-aware text). Caveats: the meridale-locales page was unreadable (403), so POSIX locales are converted to BCP 47 by assumption; and the rounding page (half up) contradicts the changelog (half even) - I followed the rounding page.
